segments.an3.27:1.3: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:1.4: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:1.5: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:1.6: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo?
segments.an3.27:1.7: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
segments.an3.27:1.8: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:1.10: Kiñcāpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati –
segments.an3.27:1.12: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ahi gūthagato kiñcāpi na daṃsati [ḍaṃsati (sī. syā.), ḍassati (pī.)], atha kho naṃ makkheti;
segments.an3.27:1.13: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati –
segments.an3.27:1.15: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:2.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo?
segments.an3.27:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.an3.27:2.4: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, duṭṭhāruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti;
segments.an3.27:2.5: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave … pe … seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, tindukālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhiyyosomattāya cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati;
segments.an3.27:2.7: evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave … pe … seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gūthakūpo kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya duggandho hoti;
segments.an3.27:2.9: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
segments.an3.27:2.11: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:2.13: Akkoseyyapi maṃ paribhāseyyapi maṃ anatthampi maṃ kareyyāti.
segments.an3.27:2.14: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:3.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo?
segments.an3.27:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo.
segments.an3.27:3.3: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:3.5: Kiñcāpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati –
segments.an3.27:3.7: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
segments.an3.27:3.8: ‘Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin’”ti.

lines: Evameva khoti ettha gūthakūpo viya dussīlyaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Gūthakūpe patitvā ṭhito dhammaniahi viya dussīlapuggalo.
Gūthakūpato uddhariyamānena tena ahinā purisassa sarīraṃ āruḷhenāpi adaṭṭhabhāvo viya dussīlaṃ sevamānassāpi tassa kiriyāya akaraṇabhāvo.
Sarīraṃ gūthena makkhetvā ahinā gatakālo viya dussīlaṃ sevamānassa pāpakittisaddaabbhuggamanakālo veditabbo.

words: tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo
lines: Bhiyyosomattāya cicciṭāyatīti taṃ hi jhāyamānaṃ pakatiyāpi papaṭikāyo muñcantaṃ cicciṭāti “ciṭiciṭā”ti saddaṃ karoti, ghaṭṭitaṃ pana adhimattaṃ karotīti attho.

Evameva khoti evamevaṃ kodhano attano dhammatāyapi uddhato caṇḍikato hutvā carati, appamattakaṃ pana vacanaṃ sutakāle “mādisaṃ nāma evaṃ vadati evaṃ vadatī”ti atirekataraṃ uddhato caṇḍikato hutvā carati.
Tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabboti yasmā kodhano atiseviyamāno atiupasaṅkamiyamānopi kujjhatiyeva,“kiṃ iminā”ti paṭikkamantepi kujjhatiyeva.
Tasmā palālaggi viya ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo.
Yo hi palālaggiṃ atiupasaṅkamitvā tappati, tassa sarīraṃ jhāyati.
Yo atipaṭikkamitvā tappati, tassa sītaṃ na vūpasammati.

Anupasaṅkamitvā apaṭikkamitvā pana majjhattabhāvena tappantassa sītaṃ vūpasammati, tasmā palālaggi viya kodhano puggalo majjhattabhāvena ajjhupekkhitabbo, na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
Sattame abbhuggacchatīti ettha abhi-saddāpekkhāya “nan”ti sāmiatthe upayogavacananti āha “assā”ti “taṃ kho pana bhavantan”tiādīsu viya.
Gūthakūpo viya dussīlyanti etena dussīlassa gūthasadisattameva dasseti.
